svg.text: Pulp Riot: supply network, physical flow and information flow
Every box is a row in nodes.csv and every arrow a row in edges.csv. Red marks the three bottlenecks that failed last summer; Supply and Inventory are the two modules modelled in depth.
targets set on price per kg
pulp cover at closure start: 14 days
Depot-to-depot transfers (any depot to any depot)
Cover set from last year's mix, reset monthly.
Each depot reports weekly in its own spreadsheet.
Other suppliers: arrows exist in the case; lead times not stated.
launch notice: 2 weeks before launch (imported pulp needs 6-8)
No second supplier, no alternative route; road closed 1+ week in 3 of the last 5
summers. Plants held ~2 weeks of pulp, the closure lasted 3. Feeds Passionfruit
